title: Baap ke Sog Mein
body:
Baap ke sog mein
Baap ke sog me chalees baras roye hai
Aaj sajjad hamesha ke leye soye hai
1-Kabhi koshish bhi agar karte the so jane ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi tasveer ubher aati thi tarpane ki
Gonjne lagte thi kaano me Sakina ki sada’n
2-Samne jab bhi wazu ke leye aaya pani
Roke kahte the ke baba ne na paya pani
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil sulag jata tha aur saaso se utha tha dhuaa’n
3-Shaamo khofa ki who tasweer bhulayi na gayi
Umr bhar paaon ki bhulayi na gayi
Marte dam tak na gaye pusht se durron ke nisha’n
<<DIVIDER>>
4-  Phoot kar rahe paaon ke chaley har dum
Rahe pur khaar pe bhadtey hi rahe haye qadam
Ek pal ko bhi mayassar hua araam kha’n
5-Har ghari honton pe noha yeh raha haye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhari saas bhi aayi toh kaha haye Hussain
Yaad me baba ki duniya se gaye tashna daha’n
6-Khul gaya taoq magar dard ki shiddat na gayi
Bedhiya khul ke bhi zakhmo ki aziyat na gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Paye ehsaas me jakhdi rahi zanjeer e gira’n
7-Ghar se jab aabid e muztar ka janaza nikla
Sogwaro ki zubano se yeh nauha nikla aamir o
Fakhri madine me thi yeh aaho fogha’n
<<DIVIDER>>
